item.description: With six memorable weeks, over 85 original songs, and a lineup of emerging independent pop artists from across the country, Amazon MX Player's I-POPSTAR held a spectacular finale for its debut season, setting a new standard for music reality shows in India. With strong audience engagement, breakout songs that captured social media, and artists becoming overnight sensations, the finale concluded a season that celebrated originality and the rebirth of Indian pop music. item.description: Mumbai recently witnessed a very special and large-scale campaign. The campaign aimed to raise awareness about mental health. It was a wonderful, joyous sight, with so many people, whether first-timers or families, joining in this noble cause.
